selection_rule: Mean overall seedwise MCC descending, then ROC-AUC descending, then sensitivity-specificity gap ascending; exact ties use lr/rf/xgb and wmean/max order.
selection_reason: Rank 1 under the declared deterministic exploratory ranking.
scope: Exploratory model/representation comparison, not unbiased performance of winner-selection. Repeated seeds are not independent cohorts. No final refit is performed here.
